result.summary: The home screen is mostly intact. The only notable visual defect is a restaurant name truncated in the Fastest carousel; other edge clipping matches intended horizontal/vertical scroll behavior.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word under the third Fastest-near-you card, so the full title is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, use a smaller type size, or fade/ellipsis the text so it stays fully readable within the card width.
